subject: Coffee & Tea
title: The One-Way Valve
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The One-Way Valve.

hook.text: That little plastic circle on your coffee bag isn't decoration. It's engineering that keeps coffee fresh.

buildup.text: Freshly roasted beans release CO₂ for days. Without a vent, the bag would inflate and burst.

discovery.text: The one-way valve lets CO₂ out but doesn't let oxygen in. Gas escapes; freshness stays locked inside.

twist.text: Before one-way valves, roasters had to wait days before packaging. The valve changed the entire supply chain.

climax.text: You can sniff through the valve to smell the beans without opening the bag and starting oxidation.

punchline.text: One tiny valve. CO₂ out, oxygen blocked. Freshness preserved.

quiz.question: What does the one-way valve on a coffee bag do?
options: Lets CO₂ out without letting oxygen in
